mainPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one high-resolution landscape editorial photograph for a portfolio case hero, 3:2 composition. AI editorial concept, not documentary evidence. Generate a completely new photograph, not an edit of a reference photo.
Input images: 1 is ONLY the six-vane radial-emblem geometry, recolor it orange; 2 and 3 are ONLY real taxi livery placement references, do NOT copy their yellow cars, purple palette or people; 4 is ONLY bold sans-serif wordmark character/weight inspiration, replace its Cyrillic copy with the exact Latin word specified below; 5 is ONLY the severe directional lighting, diagonal shadow and restrained film-photograph mood, do NOT retain the Porsche or its design.
Primary request: a believable WHITE Volkswagen Nivus compact coupe SUV in a strict left-side profile, nose pointing right, parked on asphalt in front of a restrained brutalist board-formed concrete building. A four-door modern Volkswagen Nivus with a gently descending coupe roofline, plausible doors/windows/wheelbase, straight wheels, one pair of intact wheels visible, ordinary factory proportions. No Porsche, no sports-car conversion.
Livery: clean white body. A large ORANGE six-vane radial star on the rear door/rear-quarter area following the placement logic of references 2/3; a single bold Latin CityMobil wordmark across the side doors, EXACT spelling C i t y M o b i l. City is orange, Mobil is black; visually one word, with capital C and M. All lettering is physically printed on the car surface with plausible seams and perspective. Preserve the distinctive fan-like six broad tapered radial vanes and white gaps of reference 1, not a generic pointed star. Orange is a visual concept color from the direct brief, not a claim of an official HEX. No blue or purple invented onto the car.
Scene/composition: wide architectural editorial image; car occupies about the central 60 percent of frame width, its complete silhouette and wheels fit with generous breathing room. Camera perpendicular to the left side at waist/headlight height, restrained long-lens perspective. Keep the car in the middle/lower-middle band and the entire livery grouping concentrated near the center so a portrait crop can still show the wordmark. Useful quiet dark asphalt along the bottom, especially the lower-left, for separately editable portfolio text; NO typography or UI outside the livery.
Light/style: match reference 5's unusually crisp severe sun and large diagonal architectural shadow, deep charcoal shadow across part of the concrete wall and foreground, warm-neutral sunlit concrete and a luminous but not blown-out white car. Strong photographic light/shade separation, single physically consistent direction, grounded contact shadow, modest fine film grain and rich low-key magazine contrast. Preserve real car material, black trim, glass reflections, rubber and concrete texture. No haze, wet neon city, motion blur, fog, exaggerated vignette or glossy CGI.
Text (verbatim, only on vehicle): "CityMobil"
Avoid: people/passengers, extra slogans, numbers, watermark, fake UI, purple/yellow body, Cyrillic wordmark, duplicated or misspelled letters, deformed wheel/door geometry, flattened poster graphic, oversized roof advertisement.
